description: Shared client libraries: pure helpers (roles, formatting/CSV), the additive firebase.ts extension, Firestore data-access + models (applications.ts), and typed callable wrappers (adminApi.ts). These are the foundation every admin component imports. Independent of the Cloud Functions work (FEAT-004) except that adminApi.ts's callable names must match FEAT-004's exports — those names are fixed by the design, so no runtime dependency during build.
steps: Create src/lib/roles.ts: export type Role = 'superadmin'|'admin'|'viewer'; a ROLE_RANK record (viewer<admin<superadmin) for ordering/guards; pure predicates canManageAdmins(role), canEditApplications(role), canExport(role); and roleLabelHe(role) returning Hebrew labels. No React and no firebase imports (keep it Layer-0 pure and unit-testable). If importing the Role type across files, use 'import type' (verbatimModuleSyntax is on).

Create src/lib/format.ts: formatDateHe(iso: string) and formatDateTimeHe(iso: string) using new Intl.DateTimeFormat('he-IL', ...) — BOTH accept an ISO-8601 string ONLY (caller converts any Firestore Timestamp via ts?.toDate().toISOString() first). Export the shared non-gender missing-value fallback constant '—'. Export toCsv(rows, columns) producing a UTF-8-BOM-prefixed CSV string with correct quoting/escaping of commas, quotes, and newlines, and downloadCsv(filename, content) that triggers a browser download via a Blob + object URL.

Extend src/lib/firebase.ts ADDITIVELY: add imports getFirestore from 'firebase/firestore' and getFunctions from 'firebase/functions'; add 'export const db = getFirestore(app);' and 'export const functions = getFunctions(app, "europe-west1");'. Leave the existing 'export const app' and 'export const auth = getAuth(app)' lines EXACTLY as-is. Do NOT add setPersistence (browserLocalPersistence is the getAuth default and satisfies FR-1.2; a bare setPersistence would be a floating promise racing AuthContext).

Create src/lib/applications.ts: export interface Application with required name/phone/email/city/createdAt/status and id, and optional idNum?/birthdate?/gender?/age?/background?/motivation? (because exports.apply writes a shape without idNum/birthdate/gender); export type ApplicationStatus = 'new'|'contacted'|'interview'|'accepted'|'rejected'; export status label map (Hebrew: חדש/נוצר קשר/ראיון/התקבל/נדחה) and a status order array; export genderLabelHe(code?: string) mapping '7'->'זכר','0'->'נקבה','1'->'אחר', else 'לא צוין'. Export fetchApplicationsPage(opts) using query(collection(db,'applications'), orderBy('createdAt','desc'), optional where('status','==',value), limit(25)) with cursor via startAfter(lastDoc); fetchApplication(id) via getDoc; subscribeApplicationHistory(id, cb) via onSnapshot over applications/{id}/history ordered by at, mapping each entry's at via data.at?.toDate().toISOString() ?? null BEFORE formatting (null = pending). Use 'import type' for type-only firebase imports. GUARD: as the FIRST statement of every data-access entry point (fetchApplicationsPage, fetchApplication, subscribeApplicationHistory), if import.meta.env.DEV && import.meta.env.VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE === '1', return in-memory fixtures (or filter/subscribe over them) and issue NO Firestore query/listener. Export the fixture data so tests and other modules share it.

Create src/lib/adminApi.ts: thin typed wrappers grantRole(email, role), revokeAdmin(uid), listAdmins(), setApplicationStatus(appId, status) over httpsCallable(functions, '<name>') with request/response TS interfaces. Map Firebase FunctionsError codes to the Hebrew messages from the design Error Handling section (e.g. permission-denied -> 'רק מנהל על יכול לבצע פעולה זו' for admin calls / 'אין לך הרשאה לשנות סטטוס' for status; not-found -> 'המשתמש לא קיים במערכת ההזדהות — צרו קודם חשבון' / 'המועמד לא נמצא'; failed-precondition -> the guard message; invalid-argument -> 'קלט לא תקין'/'ערך לא תקין'; internal/unknown -> 'השמירה נכשלה, נסו שוב'). GUARD: as the FIRST statement of each wrapper, if import.meta.env.DEV && VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE === '1', mutate/read the in-memory fixtures from applications.ts and invoke NO callable.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with the new src/lib files present (tsc strict + verbatimModuleSyntax + noUnusedLocals satisfied).
npm run lint is clean (no new errors).
firebase.ts still exports app and auth unchanged and additionally exports db and functions.
findings:
Created src/lib/{roles,format,applications,adminApi}.ts and extended src/lib/firebase.ts additively. npm run build (exit 0) and npm run lint (clean) both pass. firebase.ts preserves app and auth=getAuth(app) exactly and adds db=getFirestore(app) and functions=getFunctions(app,'europe-west1'); NO setPersistence (SDK default browserLocalPersistence). ApplyWizard.tsx and webhook.ts untouched.

Exports later steps depend on:
- roles.ts: type Role='superadmin'|'admin'|'viewer'; ROLE_RANK (viewer<admin<superadmin); canManageAdmins/canEditApplications/canExport(role); roleLabelHe(role) -> 'מנהל על'/'מנהל'/'צופה'. Use 'import type { Role }'.
- format.ts: MISSING='—'; formatDateHe(iso)/formatDateTimeHe(iso) (ISO-8601 string ONLY — convert Timestamp via ts?.toDate().toISOString() first); toCsv(rows, columns: CsvColumn<Row>[]) returns UTF-8-BOM CSV (CRLF rows, RFC4180 quoting); downloadCsv(filename, content). CsvColumn<Row> = {key, header, value?(row)=>string}.
- applications.ts: interface Application (id,name,phone,email,city,createdAt,status required; idNum?/birthdate?/gender?/age?/background?/motivation? optional); type ApplicationStatus; STATUS_LABEL_HE; STATUS_ORDER; genderLabelHe(code?) ('7'->זכר,'0'->נקבה,'1'->אחר,else 'לא צוין'); interface HistoryEntry (at: string|null, null=pending); fetchApplicationsPage({status?,lastDoc?})->{applications,lastDoc,hasMore} (PAGE_SIZE=25, orderBy createdAt desc, optional where status); fetchApplication(id)->Application|null; subscribeApplicationHistory(id,cb)->unsubscribe. Exported fixtures: FIXTURE_APPLICATIONS (3 docs incl. a legacy HTTP-shape doc with age and no gender), FIXTURE_HISTORY. Test-mode guard (import.meta.env.DEV && VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE==='1') is the FIRST statement of every data-access entry point; serves fixtures, no Firestore call.
- adminApi.ts: grantRole(email,role), revokeAdmin(uid), listAdmins(), setApplicationStatus(appId,status) over httpsCallable(functions,'<name>'). Callable names are fixed: 'grantRole','revokeAdmin','listAdmins','setApplicationStatus' — FEAT-004 MUST export exactly these. FunctionsError codes mapped to Hebrew (permission-denied/not-found/invalid-argument per design; failed-precondition surfaces server message verbatim; fallback 'השמירה נכשלה, נסו שוב'). Test-mode guard first in each wrapper: mutates/reads FIXTURE_APPLICATIONS (setApplicationStatus mutates target.status), invokes no callable.

Notes for later steps: VITE_ADMIN_TEST_MODE is NOT yet added to .env.example (that is in the FEAT that touches config/.env.example, not this one). Pre-existing vite 'chunk > 500 kB' warning is unrelated and exits 0.
